units.text: Aspose.PSD FOSS for Python reads Adobe Photoshop .psd and .psb files, inspects their metadata, layers, channel information, blend modes, masks, image resources, and image-data structures (RLE and ZIP compression), and saves the files back to .psd or .psb format. It exposes document properties such as width, height, channels, bits_per_channel, color_mode, version, is_psb, layer_count, resource_count, compression, and image_data_kind through the PsdImage class. It provides access to layer objects with properties like name, bounds, blendmode, and channelinformation, and supports reading image resources and imagedata sections. The library runs on Python 3.7+ and depends only on the standard library.
Document metadata inspection exposes width, height, channels, bits_per_channel, color_mode, version, is_psb, layer_count, resource_count, compression, and image_data_kind through the PsdImage class.
Layer model access provides layer name, bounds, opacity, visibility, clipping, blend_mode_key, channels_count, and channel_information through the layer class.
Blend mode handling maps 4-character PSD keys to enum values using the BlendMode enum and LayerBlendModeMapper.
Mask and blending ranges expose raw length and basic properties through LayerMaskDataShort and LayerBlendingRangesData, with mutations not supported.
Image resource parsing handles unknown resources via ImageResourcesSection, preserving raw payloads, with UnknownResource exposing resource_id, name, and data.
Byte-exact round-trip saving preserves all unmodified sections, enabling lossless save-load cycles through PsdImage.save.
Non-seekable stream support enables loading from streams that do not support seeking using BigEndianReader, PsdSectionReader, and StreamContainer.
This example loads a PSD file and prints each layer's index, name, and bounds to inspect the image structure.

The public entry point is the aspose_psd_foss package. It provides the aspose_psd_foss.PsdImage class to load, inspect, and save Adobe Photoshop files, with methods for accessing layers, resources, color mode, compression, and other core properties.

The aspose_psd_foss.PsdImage class represents a loaded Photoshop document and exposes its aspose_psd_foss.PsdImage.width, aspose_psd_foss.PsdImage.height, aspose_psd_foss.PsdImage.color_mode, aspose_psd_foss.PsdImage.compression, aspose_psd_foss.PsdImage.has_layers, aspose_psd_foss.PsdImage.has_image_resources, aspose_psd_foss.PsdImage.has_icc_profile, aspose_psd_foss.PsdImage.layers, aspose_psd_foss.PsdImage.load, and aspose_psd_foss.PsdImage.save members.

Loading a PSD file is performed via the aspose_psd_foss.Image.load method, which supports loading from a file path using aspose_psd_foss.ImageLoader.load_from_path or from a stream using aspose_psd_foss.ImageLoader.load_from_stream, returning an aspose_psd_foss.PsdImage instance when the input is a Photoshop document.

Saving a aspose_psd_foss.PsdImage instance is done by calling its aspose_psd_foss.PsdImage.save method, which accepts a file path or a stream and uses the aspose_psd_foss.writedescriptors.psdimagewriter descriptor to write the output.

The aspose_psd_foss.PsdImage.layers property returns a collection of aspose_psd_foss.layers.layer objects, and the aspose_psd_foss.PsdImage.layer_count property indicates how many layers the document contains.

The aspose_psd_foss.PsdImage.resources property provides access to the document's resource blocks, and the aspose_psd_foss.PsdImage.image_resources property returns the image resources section, which contains aspose_psd_foss.ResourceBlock instances within the aspose_psd_foss.sections.imageresourcessection.
The aspose_psd_foss.PsdImage.active_layer property returns the currently active aspose_psd_foss.layers.layer in the document.

The aspose_psd_foss.PsdImage.color_mode property indicates the color mode of the document, represented by values from the aspose_psd_foss.ColorModes enumeration, and the underlying color data kind is defined in aspose_psd_foss.sections.psdcolordatakind.

The aspose_psd_foss.PsdImage.compression property specifies the compression method used for the image data, represented by values from the aspose_psd_foss.CompressionMethod enumeration, and the structure of the image data is described by aspose_psd_foss.sections.imagedatastructure.
The aspose_psd_foss.PsdImage.has_layers property returns a boolean indicating whether the document contains layers, as defined in the aspose_psd_foss.sections.layerandmasksection.
The aspose_psd_foss.PsdImage.has_image_resources property returns a boolean indicating whether the document contains image resources, as defined in the aspose_psd_foss.sections.imageresourcessection.
The aspose_psd_foss.PsdImage.has_icc_profile property returns a boolean indicating whether the document contains an ICC profile, as defined in the aspose_psd_foss.resources.psdresourceinfo section.
The aspose_psd_foss.PsdImage.dispose method releases resources used by the document and accepts an aspose_psd_foss.StreamContainer instance for stream cleanup.

Aspose.PSD FOSS for Python reads and writes Photoshop Document files, exposing layer and image data through the aspose_psd_foss.layers.channelinformation, aspose_psd_foss.layers.layerblendingrangesdata, aspose_psd_foss.layers.layermaskdatashort, and aspose_psd_foss.sections.imagedata classes.
The aspose_psd_foss.layers.channelinformation class provides access to channel data but does not expose methods to modify channel content directly.

The aspose_psd_foss.layers.layerblendingrangesdata and aspose_psd_foss.layers.layermaskdatashort classes expose blending ranges and mask data structures but do not provide APIs to edit their contents.
The aspose_psd_foss.sections.imagedata class exposes image data sections but does not support programmatic modification of section contents.
The BigEndianWriter class writes data in big-endian byte order to a stream, providing methods to write bytes, integers, and Pascal strings with optional alignment.
The LayerAndMaskSectionReader class reads the layer and mask section of a PSD file, parsing layer records and associated mask data.
The Point class represents a point in two-dimensional space with X and Y coordinates.
The PsdVersion class specifies the version of the PSD file format, such as Photoshop CS6 or CC.
The Size class represents the dimensions of a rectangle with width and height values.
The GlobalLayerMaskInfo class stores global layer mask information for a PSD file.
The Layer class represents a single layer in a PSD file, containing its bounds, blending mode, opacity, and other properties.
The LayerBlendingRangesInfo class defines the blending ranges for a layer in a PSD file.
The LayerBlendModeMapper class maps blend mode keys to their string representations in a PSD file.
The LayerMaskInfo class stores mask data associated with a layer in a PSD file.
The LayerRawData class holds the raw binary data of a layer in a PSD file.
The LayerRecordReader class reads and parses layer records from a PSD file's layer section.
The LayerResource class is an abstract base class for layer resources in a PSD file.
The RawLayerBlendingRangesSection class represents the raw section containing layer blending ranges data in a PSD file.
The RawLayerMaskSection class represents the raw section containing layer mask data in a PSD file.
The PsdImageLoader class loads PSD image files from a stream or file path.
The IndexedColorPalette class represents an indexed color palette used in a PSD file.
The PsdResourceKind class specifies the type of image resource in a PSD file using an enumeration.
The PsdImageDataInfo class contains metadata about the image data section of a PSD file.
The TestAsposeCompatibility class verifies compatibility with Aspose.PSD behavior.
The TestColorData class validates color data handling in PSD files.
The TestFixtureDocument class tests document loading using fixture files.
The TestImageData class validates image data parsing in PSD files.
The TestImageResourcesSection class tests the image resources section of PSD files.
The InspectionDtoTests class validates inspection data transfer objects for PSD files.
The TestLayerSection class tests the layer section parsing in PSD files.
The TestPascalString class validates Pascal string handling in PSD files.
The TestPsdHeaderTests class validates the PSD file header parsing.
The TestPsdImageLoad class validates loading of PSD images from streams or files.
The TestPsdImagesaveTests class validates saving PSD images to streams or files.
